achievements.name: On the Ice
achievements.detail: Finish the opening drop and walk out onto the ice at the landing site.

achievements.name: First Habitat
achievements.detail: Build a powered seabase and go inside through its hatch.

achievements.name: Seatruck
achievements.detail: Fabricate a Seatruck and pilot it under the water.

achievements.name: Snowfox
achievements.detail: Craft a Snowfox and ride it across the glacier.

achievements.name: Prawn Suit
achievements.detail: Construct a Prawn Suit and walk it along the seafloor.

achievements.name: Spy Pengling
achievements.detail: Control a Spy Pengling with its remote.

achievements.name: Marguerit
achievements.detail: Find Marguerit Maida in Sector Zero and speak with her.

achievements.name: Mercury II
achievements.detail: Board one of the wrecked sections of the Mercury II.

achievements.name: Tower Down
achievements.detail: Shut off the satellite tower with a test override module.

achievements.name: Phi Robotics
achievements.detail: Reach the Phi Robotics center in the glacial basin.

achievements.name: Al-An's Body
achievements.detail: Recover the architect parts and fabricate a body for Al-An.

achievements.name: Frozen Leviathan
achievements.detail: Apply the antidote to the frozen leviathan at the dig site.

achievements.name: Phase Gate
achievements.detail: Leave Sector Zero with Al-An after his new body is ready.
